title: Nutty Ethiopian White Fish Fillets Shiro
description: A pungent and snappy Ethiopian dish featuring white fish fillets in a cozy shiro sauce, made with a pasta water emulsion and nut-free friendly ingredients. This dish is perfect for a weeknight dinner
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger and cook for an additional 1 minute
Add the berbere spice and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly
Add the white fish fillets and cook for 3-4 minutes per side, or until cooked through
Remove the fish from the saucepan and set aside
Add the pasta water to the saucepan and bring to a simmer
Reduce the heat to low and let the sauce simmer for 5 minutes
Stir in the salt and black pepper
Serve the fish fillets with the shiro sauce spooned over the top
